title: Class 9 Science RAG Chatbot
summary: A personal project: a RAG chatbot that helps Class 9 students with Science questions from NCERT textbook content, adapting answers to proficiency.
overview: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot over NCERT Science PDFs. It retrieves relevant chunks from ChromaDB, generates answers with Azure OpenAI GPT-3.5, logs conversations in MongoDB and presents a Streamlit chat interface.
problem: Students need answers tied to their textbook and pitched at their level. Retrieval over the textbook content grounds the answers, and proficiency-aware prompts adjust the depth.
approach: Pre-processed PDFs are chunked and stored as embeddings in ChromaDB.
Semantic search retrieves relevant text chunks for each question.
Answers adapt to a student's proficiency level (Weak, Neutral, Strong).
The last 10 conversations from MongoDB are used for context-aware replies.
The Streamlit UI offers quick prompts, history and expandable retrieved content.

architecture.label: Retrieval
architecture.detail: ChromaDB vector search with Azure OpenAI embeddings over NCERT Science PDFs.

architecture.label: Generation
architecture.detail: Azure OpenAI GPT-3.5 produces proficiency-adapted answers.

architecture.label: Conversation memory
architecture.detail: MongoDB logs conversations; recent ones are added to the prompt.

workflow.step: Textbook PDFs are chunked and embedded into ChromaDB.
A question retrieves the most relevant chunks.
GPT-3.5 answers at the chosen proficiency level using the retrieved text and recent conversations.

items: Built this personal project, per the public repository.

limitations: Details come from the project's public README on GitHub; no usage numbers, accuracy figures or deployment results are claimed.
Answer quality has not been formally evaluated.
